title: Cluster is a place in the switcher bar, not a filter
context: Switching cluster tabs must swap the pane tree, the project underneath it, and the terminals in the band below—the whole workspace.
decision: One tab in the switcher per cluster. Switching cluster swaps everything: pane tree, project, terminals. A terminal dragged into the layout moves into a pane tab; the band stops listing it.
consequences: Membership is exclusive: a surface is either in the tree or listed in the band, not both. Built fresh from shell:state on every render.
